title: The PPAR-alpha agonist oleoyethanolamide (OEA) ameliorates valproic acid-induced steatohepatitis in rats via suppressing Wnt3a/beta-catenin and activating PGC-1alpha: Involvement of network pharmacology and molecular docking.
authors: El Tabaa, Maram Mohammed; Faheem, Heba; Elballal, Mohammed Salah; Rashad, Eman; Mohsen, Mohamed; El Tabaa, Manar Mohammed
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究PPAR-alpha激动剂OEA对丙戊酸诱导脂肪性肝炎的保护机制，虽含分子对接但核心是药物-蛋白及信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: Liver damage is one of the most severe side effects of valproic acid (VPA) therapy. Research indicates that PPAR-alpha prevents Wnt3a/beta-catenin-induced PGC-1alpha dysregulation, which is linked to liver injury. Although PPAR-alpha activation has hepatoprotective effects, its role in preventing VPA-induced liver injury remains unclear. Our research used network analysis, molecular docking, and in-vivo validation to predict and assess targets and pathways associated with the hepatoprotective effects of oleoylethanolamide (OEA), a PPAR-alpha agonist, on VPA-induced steatohepatitis. For in-vivo experiments, 24 rats were assigned to V, OEA, VPA, and OEA + VPA. Liver functions, TGs, cholesterol, and LDL were tested. Hepatic levels of PPAR-alpha, ACO, TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, HO-1, MDA, and TAC, along with Wnt3a/beta-catenin, PGC-1alpha, and Nrf2 expression were assessed. Further, NF-kappaB, Bax, Bcl-2, and caspase-3 expression were detected immunohistochemically. Network pharmacology identified 258 targets for OEA-steatohepatitis connection, including NFKB1, PPARA, and NFE2L2, in addition to TNF, non-alcoholic fatty liver, NF-kappaB, PPAR, and WNT signaling, as contributing to steatohepatitis pathogenesis. The docking revealed a strong affinity between OEA and Wnt3a, beta-catenin, and PGC-1alpha. Therefore, we postulated that the hepatoprotective effect of OEA may be due to Wnt3a/beta-catenin-mediated inactivation of PGC1-alpha pathway. In vivo, OEA inhibited Wnt3a/beta-catenin and increased PGC1-alpha by activating PPAR-alpha. Hence, PGC1-alpha reduced fat cell beta-oxidation and NF-kappaB-mediated inflammation. OEA lessened MDA and raised TAC to mitigate oxidative damage. OEA additionally reduced apoptosis by lowering Bax/Bcl-2 ratio and caspase-3. In summary, PPAR-alpha involvement in the protective effects of OEA against VPA-induced steatohepatitis can be confirmed by suppressing Wnt3a/beta-catenin and activating PGC-1alpha signaling.
abstract_zh: 肝损伤是丙戊酸（valproic acid, VPA）治疗中最严重的副作用之一。研究表明，PPAR-alpha可防止Wnt3a/β-catenin诱导的PGC-1alpha失调，而这种失调与肝损伤相关。尽管PPAR-alpha激活具有肝脏保护作用，但其在预防VPA诱导的肝损伤中的具体作用仍不清楚。本研究采用网络分析、分子对接和体内验证，预测并评估了油酰乙醇胺（oleoylethanolamide, OEA）——一种PPAR-alpha激动剂——对VPA诱导的脂肪性肝炎的肝脏保护作用所涉及的靶点和通路。在体内实验中，24只大鼠被分为V、OEA、VPA和OEA + VPA四组。检测了肝功能、甘油三酯（TGs）、胆固醇和低密度脂蛋白（LDL）。评估了肝脏中PPAR-alpha、ACO、TNF-alpha、IL-1beta、HO-1、MDA和TAC的水平，以及Wnt3a/β-catenin、PGC-1alpha和Nrf2的表达。此外，通过免疫组化检测了NF-kappaB、Bax、Bcl-2和caspase-3的表达。网络药理学确定了OEA-脂肪性肝炎关联的258个靶点，包括NFKB1、PPARA和NFE2L2，以及TNF、非酒精性脂肪肝、NF-kappaB、PPAR和WNT信号通路，这些均参与脂肪性肝炎的发病机制。对接结果显示OEA与Wnt3a、β-catenin和PGC-1alpha之间具有强亲和力。因此，我们推测OEA的肝脏保护作用可能归因于Wnt3a/β-catenin介导的PGC1-alpha通路失活。在体内，OEA通过激活PPAR-alpha抑制了Wnt3a/β-catenin并增加了PGC1-alpha。因此，PGC1-alpha减少了脂肪细胞β-氧化和NF-kappaB介导的炎症。OEA降低了MDA并提高了TAC，以减轻氧化损伤。OEA还通过降低Bax/Bcl-2比值和caspase-3来减少细胞凋亡。总之，PPAR-alpha参与OEA对VPA诱导的脂肪性肝炎的保护作用，可通过抑制Wnt3a/β-catenin和激活PGC-1alpha信号通路得到证实。
